description: Change a message: mark it read or unread, replace its labels (the list replaces them all; an empty list removes them), or move it to another folder. Make or remove a folder with id ag_…/<name> and changes {"exists": true|false}; only an empty folder can be removed. precondition_failed on a message means other changes landed first or it is still arriving: repeat it unchanged; on a folder, it still holds mail. Labels replace whole and the last write wins, so read the message again before repeating a label change much later.

changes.description: For a message, at least one of read, labels and folder; for a folder, exists.

exists.description: true makes the folder (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens), false removes it.

folder.description: Move received mail to inbox, quarantine or a folder the mailbox made; sent mail stays in sent.

read.description: true marks it read, false unread.

id.description: The message_ id to change, or ag_…/<folder> for a folder.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same key repeats this change instead of applying it twice; never reuse one for a different change.

name: mail_put
